label: Whatever gives a thing being at a moment is present at that moment
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred (time-indexed contact principle): in every history of the model, whatever gives a thing being at a moment (the primitive GivesAt) is present at that moment. After ST I q.8 a.1: an agent must be joined to that wherein it acts immediately. It excludes giving being across a temporal gap. For a timeless agent, 'present at t' reads as co-presence to the moment, not temporal location; nothing is said about spatial location, and the agent's being in time is not asserted.
